section: Educational Psychology · Ch13 — Assessment: Reliability & Tools (Complete)
subject: Educational Psychology
stem: A test made up entirely of multiple-choice, true/false, and matching questions, each with one single fixed correct answer that any examiner would score identically, is called a/an:
explanation: Objective-type tests (MCQ, true/false, matching) have a single fixed correct answer, ensuring high scorer objectivity — contrasted with essay-type tests, which require extended written answers scored more subjectively based on judgement.
